info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Agreement Retrieval API
info.description: The Customer Agreement Retrieval API enables businesses to access detailed information regarding customer agreements stored in the system. This endpoint is primarily utilized for retrieving specific agreements based on customer identifiers. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and banking personnel who need to view agreement specifics for customer inquiries or compliance checks. The API streamlines access to vital contract details, enhancing operational efficiency and customer interactions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific customer agreement using its unique identifier. It provides all relevant information associated with the agreement, enabling effective management and review.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving customer agreement details for the specified customer ID. This body must comply with the schema for the correct data structure.

GetCustomerAgreementByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the customer agreement operation. It is expected to contain a string value.

partyId.description: Unique identifier for the party involved in the agreement.

productCode.description: Code representing the product associated with the customer agreement.

effectiveDate.description: Date when the agreement becomes effective.

relationshipTier.description: Tier level of the customer's relationship.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the agreement record.

version.description: Version number of the customer agreement.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the agreement was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the agreement.
